sentences.text: The present petition has been filed seeking quashing of FIR No.295/2016 under Sections 498A/406/34 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 (IPC) registered at Police Station Sarai Rohilla on the ground of settlement.
2. Counsel for the petitioner submits that the parties have settled the matter vide Memorandum of Settlement dated 26th February, 2018, which has been duly signed by the parties.
3. The respondent no.2, who is present in Court, disputes the aforesaid submission of the counsel for the petitioner and submits that she was made to sign the blank papers.

sentences.text: The respondent no.2 submits that she is willing to settle the case if the jewellery given to her by her parents at the time of marriage is returned to her.
6. Counsel for the petitioner submits that no jewellery was given at the time of the wedding.
7. In view of the aforesaid, learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner seeks time to take instructions.
